description: This PHP class 'AcunetixOutputProcessor' processes XML output files from Acunetix vulnerability scans, extracting vulnerability information and encapsulating it into 'Vulnerability' objects within a 'ProcessorResult'. It extends 'AbstractOutputProcessor' and is part of a command output parsing module.

classes.name: AcunetixOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing Acunetix scan XML reports and extracting vulnerability data into internal models.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Parses the given XML file to extract vulnerabilities and returns a ProcessorResult containing these vulnerabilities.
